text: CONSOLIDATION BY THE CHIEF: two open P2s are INSTANCES of this sweep and must not be solved independently, or we will get three different shapes for one disease. bd-01M161EEPDV8NMC932KA8AY0QC (ExternalMassReport publicly constructible in invalid states: negative, >1, NaN, inconsistent) and bd-01M16233J4HK16H3VHGWEHBN3K (SignatureProjection is a public case class accepting scientifically invalid constructions) are both the case-class-is-not-a-boundary defect in align. Whoever takes an align slice of this sweep takes both, and closes them with it. Note that SignatureProjection has a SECOND, independent defect that this sweep does NOT address and that must not be conflated with it: its apply returns Either[ProjectionError, Double], a bare scalar summed from components whose support differs, so the output carries no support at all - see post-01M169HBVPQS5ACYQ1R2TWRE1S. Closing the constructibility hole does not close the estimand hole. Both must be true before that type is sound.
